notes.title: We're on Patreon! (Plus a New Free Horror Title)
notes.content:
Patreon
We had some awesome fans in the past who asked about ways to donate and/or support us and the creation of Concluse 2, and we'd like to share that we now have a Patreon. The Patreon is a way to support us in the form of a monthly subscription, while getting various rewards based off the amount pledged. Rewards can include access to patron-only posts (like behind the scenes looks at Concluse 2 development), early access to free games, access to exclusive games and game editions, beta access to paid titles, free download keys for paid titles, and even custom shirts and a place in the credits of our future games.

If you have interest in supporting us and the getting any of the above rewards, you can do so starting at just $1/month here: https://www.patreon.com/StudioSnowspotAndTAllenStudios

The Emulator
Now for another bit of news: We have released another free horror experience that we made for a week long game jam; in which we won both best game and scariest game. Though it has received multiple updates since. The Emulator is a short horror game based on the premise of finding a way to survive in a house with a killer released from the deep web. You can get The Emulator on itch.io or GooglePlay via the links below:
https://t-allen-studios.itch.io/the-emulator
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.StudioSnowspot_TAllenStudios.TheEmulator
https://youtu.be/-RcFr97tFPM

notes.title: Patch Notes 5 - Higher Res Notes, 60+ FPS, Fixed Inverted Option
notes.content:
While hard at work with CONCLUSE 2, we wanted to address some of the last remaining issues players have reported in the past with CONCLUSE. The biggest of those being the hard to read notes. We have redone all of the ones we felt had been the most reported and caused the most difficulty in game. Below you can see a before and after of the 'infamous' sewer puzzle note:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/2a32d10f4ecab2de4d67dc8348a583f19a4b4a9b.png

The other two changes in this patch are the addition of a 60 fps option (many of you already know that  by default the game is capped to 20), and a fix for the inverted controls option. We of course understand that not everyone wants to play the game with framerates experienced on the 20+ year old PS1, especially steamers who are also running recording software. The inverted controls fix removed the inverted x-axis, so that now only the y-axis is inverted.

The notes portion of this patch was also part of our mobile 1.3.9 update along with some scene specific tweaks.

Thank you for reading, we hope you're as excited as we are going forward with CONCLUSE 2!

notes.title: Patch Notes 4 - Windowed Mode; Invert Mouse/Look X,Y; Resolution Options
notes.content:
Introducing the 'Options Patch', while these options likely should have been included with release, they're here now. We know that some of our players have a hard time seeing what's going on with the very low default resolution, and that other players resolutions are stretching to a 16:9 ratio regardless. Now there are 5 resolution options to choose, ranging from the default 472x319 up to 1920x1080. Along with this, there is a simple toggle to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode. The other option we decided to include in this patch is the ability to invert the mouse/right joystick. We hadn't previously thought of this option, but after it being brought up in the discussions we decided to include it. After all, we want as many people to be able to play and enjoy the game as possible.

Changelog

Added OPTIONS menu to titlescreen.
Invert look x,y axis option.
Fullscreen/windowed option.
Five resolution options.
Ctrl-R hotkey added for resetting the resolution (in case of a resolution going off-screen and being unable to navigate to fix it).
Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Community Event Conclusion
notes.content:
Well it has been a week since we announced the fan community fan art event! We were very happy with the outcome, with over 10 pieces of artwork submitted to enhance our community hub. We had everything from memes, to sketches, to full blown 3d renderings. With that said it's time to announce our winner:
12th Path to Daisy - by Raincoat
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1437805584
We loved all the submissions, but this one had me checking with Jon that it wasn't a screenshot from a part of the web series I had missed lol. Congragulations @Raincoat! We will be reaching out to you to get your shirt size, shipping address, etc.

Now we also decided to choose a runner up who we will be winning a smaller prize, and that goes to:
Kaukaz in CONCLUSE - by KAUKAZ
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1435349862
We really liked the hand drawn/sketched out piece you did, it showed many aspects of the web series and we thought it was awesome that you blended your persona into the piece.

Thank you to everyone who participated! We will be reaching out to the winner and runner up soon.

notes.title: Final Trailer Released - Count Down to Game Release
notes.content:
Final Trailer
At long last the game's final trailer is here. After much hard work on the part of Studio Snowspot, we are proud to present the final trailer. Also, we have announced the winners of our early access soundtrack give away in the video description.
https://youtu.be/s0eQiMUZBIE
13 Days to Go
We're getting close! T Allen Studios is finishing coding and implementing some final 'polish features' like changing footstep sound effects when walking on different surfaces, and both Studio Snowspot and T Allen Studios are conducting tests and fixing any bugs that appear. We hope to have the game completely tested mid-week so we can start the Steamworks build process early, ensuring we get CONCLUSE in your hands as planned the 29th.

- T Allen Studios & Studio Snowspot

notes.title: Release Date Teaser
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/zhQrfUH1IcM
Release Date
As you can now see on the Steam page and in the video above, we now have a public release date. On June 29th, Concluse will be available to download free, as will the official soundtrack. Though the soundtrack will be available on other platforms June 21st for $5.99 as a way of supporting the artists who contributed to it, read the previous article for more information Here.
Final Trailer
Due to the desire to make the final trailer really do the game and its fans justice, we will be leaving you with the release date trailer for now. Over the next couple of weeks Studio Snowspot will be preparing the final trailer, as T Allen Studios works on finishing hooking things up in the games later areas along with some final features.

As always thank you for checking in, and we hope you guys are as excited as we are! The game is almost in your hands!

- T Allen Studios & Studio Snowspot

notes.title: Preparing for Testing
notes.content:
Polishing and Visual Updates
In the last development log, we shared with you the Sewers of Cordova. Since then a lot of work has gone into polishing all of the other pre-existing game areas, as well as adding a couple new ones.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/52f46e88a142f3d9b7ee487f2a4bd17031dfb6f9.png

Studio Snowspot has also introduced a couple other visual enhancements that increase immersion. Including rotatable 3d models of item pick ups, along with custom made notes that have replaced the plain text we used previously.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/9d1e6e6cbe9f08e8db78c1eeecd105da50a9472c.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/e4491bdb748bbfc652cba6cce119a413e5390176.png

Technical/Programming Update
The most recent programming problems being worked on included tracking a multitude of things between scenes. Since players are able to go back and forth between areas as they please (presuming they have the necessary items), it was important to find a solution to keep things in each area as the player left them. We're happy to have this fully working at the time of this update.

We're now working on a save/load system that will allow multiple save slots, along with some other minor features. There are some other things that could be mentioned, but we can't spill everything can we? 

Thank you for reading and following our progress!

- T Allen Studios & Studio Snowspot

notes.title: A Journey Into the Darkness
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to our first community announcement! 

For this first announcement we want to give you guys a glimpse into what we've been working on the most over the last week:

The Sewers of Cordova

Currently featuring approximately 30 minutes of content, the sewers below Cordova have been expanded since the game's original release on the PlayStation. Find keys, solve puzzles, and most importantly: get out.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/15d64b3147131ce6ed5c9252f468094eb09a8c84.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/aaf2438caad2e0bc764d20aa56873891ab0a9042.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391998/dd43c5e4152b282c73907fed6dede278893f49b6.png

Controller Support

Concluse will feature full Xbox 360 controller support on both it's PC and Mac releases. We are doing our best to integrate controllers in a way that feels natural and fits with common first person controller set ups.


Thank you guys for following the game, we hope that when it's done you love it as much as we do!

- T Allen Studios & Studio Snowspot
